ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: On the left side of the figure there is a data input X, which branches along a vertical bus to four AND gates on the right; at the top there are two selection inputs S1 and S0, and in the figure the inverted signals of S1 and S0 are provided through small boxes marked with inverted outputs. The four AND gates respectively receive X and one selection combination of S1 and S0, and the output terminals are labeled in sequence as P0, P1, P2, P3. Then reason: The four outputs can be written in the corresponding selection minterm form: P0 = X·S1'·S0', P1 = X·S1'·S0, P2 = X·S1·S0', P3 = X·S1·S0. For any one group of gating signals S1S0, only one minterm is 1, therefore only the corresponding one output terminal transmits the input X, and the remaining outputs are 0. This circuit distributes the single input data X to one of four outputs according to the selection signals, so the logic function is a data distributor, that is, a 1-line-to-4-line demultiplexer.

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit structure from the image: a single data input X is fanned out to four AND gates, while select inputs S1 and S0 and their complements are distributed so that each AND gate corresponds to one select minterm. Then write the output expressions for P0 through P3 as X AND one of the four possible select combinations. Since the select lines choose which one of four outputs carries the input X, conclude that the circuit's logical function is a data distributor, i.e. a 1-to-4 demultiplexer.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中左侧有一个数据输入 X，它沿竖直母线分支到右侧四个与门；上方有两个选择输入 S1 和 S0，并且图中通过带反相输出标记的小方框提供了 S1、S0 的反相信号。四个与门分别接收 X 以及 S1、S0 的一种选择组合，输出端依次标为 P0、P1、P2、P3。

再推理：四个输出可写成对应的选择最小项形式：P0 = X·S1'·S0'，P1 = X·S1'·S0，P2 = X·S1·S0'，P3 = X·S1·S0。对于任意一组选通信号 S1S0，只有一个最小项为 1，因此只有对应的一个输出端传送输入 X，其余输出为 0。该电路把单个输入数据 X 按选择信号分配到四个输出之一，所以逻辑功能是数据分配器，即 1 线-4 线解复用器。
